caption: Full + log backup, then proof the backup actually restores.

code:
function Invoke-MeridianHealthCheck {
  param([string]$SqlInstance = "MERSQLPRD01")
  $disk   = Get-DbaDiskSpace -ComputerName $SqlInstance |
              Where-Object Free -lt 50
  $backup = Test-DbaLastBackup -SqlInstance $SqlInstance `
              -Database MeridianCommerce
  $jobs   = Get-DbaAgentJobHistory -SqlInstance $SqlInstance `
              -StartDate (Get-Date).AddDays(-1) |
              Where-Object Status -eq 'Failed'
  [PSCustomObject]@{ LowDiskVolumes=$disk.Count } |
    Send-MeridianAlert -Severity Info
}
caption: One 7:05 AM message instead of 40 minutes clicking through SSMS.
